name: preppy
description: Check your meal plan, shopping list and recipes in Preppy from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Stop asking 'what are we eating today?'. Preppy lets you check your weekly meal plan, see your shopping list, mark items as bought, save recipes to your library and swap planned meals, using your own Preppy account. Every change is proposed first and applied only after you confirm, and confirmed changes can be undone. Preppy works on your Personal profile. It does not buy groceries, process payments, delete data in bulk or give medical or dietary advice; nutrition values are indicative only.
defaultPrompt: What's for dinner today in my plan?
Swap Wednesday's lunch for one of my saved recipes.

positive.description: Read today's dinner from the personal weekly plan
positive.prompt: What do I have planned for dinner today in my personal plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account_snapshot for the Personal workspace and returns today's planned dinner from the sample plan (e.g. 'Ensalada completa con huevo'). Does not invent meals.

positive.prompt: Show me my personal shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the computed shopping list items from the Personal workspace. If the list is not computed, says so instead of inventing items.

positive.description: Mark an item as bought (propose, confirm, optional undo)
positive.prompt: Mark the milk as bought in my personal list.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes the change and shows a diff; applies it only after the user confirms. The confirmed change can be undone with propose_revert + confirm_change.

positive.description: Save a recipe to the personal library
positive.prompt: Save this tortilla recipe to my personal library: eggs, potatoes, onion, olive oil, salt.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes saving the recipe, shows what will be saved, and saves it only after confirmation. It can be undone with propose_revert.

positive.description: Swap a planned meal for an existing recipe
positive.prompt: Replace Wednesday's lunch with my Zapallitos rellenos recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes swapping Wednesday lunch (Fideos con tuco) for Zapallitos rellenos, applies it only after confirmation, and can undo it with propose_revert + confirm_change.

negative.description: Purchases and payments are not supported
negative.prompt: Buy these groceries at the supermarket and pay for them.

negative.description: Family workspace is not available to this account
negative.prompt: Show me my family's meal plan.

review.commerce_description: Preppy does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Fixed reviewer sign-in: the connector login page now accepts email and password (in addition to Google).
